accessibilityPage.title: Accessibility statement
accessibilityPage.intro: Bowling — Ramat Gan branch places great importance on providing equal, accessible service to all our customers, and works to make both the website and the physical venue accessible in accordance with the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law and its regulations, and the Israeli standard SI 5568 based on the WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.

sections.title: Website accessibility
items: The site can be navigated using the keyboard alone.
Hierarchical heading structure and alt text on images for screen readers.
High color contrast and text that can be enlarged up to 200% without loss of content.
Compatibility with common browsers and mobile devices.

sections.title: Physical venue accessibility
items: Accessible parking near the venue entrance.
Accessible entrance and passages for wheelchairs.
Our staff is happy to assist with any request or special need.

general.title: Settings
general.name: Location name
general.nameTip: Branch name shown to customers across the site and in the location switcher (e.g. Bowling Ramat Gan).
general.addressLine1Tip: Street and number, shown on the contact page and in the footer (e.g. Herzl St 10).
general.addressLine2Tip: Optional second line such as floor, entrance or mall name. Leave blank if not needed.
general.addressFullTip: Complete address used for map links and directions. Include city and postal code.
general.phoneTip: Public phone number; becomes a click-to-call link on mobile (e.g. 03-1234567).
general.whatsappTip: Number for the WhatsApp chat button. International format, digits only — no + or spaces (e.g. 972501234567).
general.emailTip: Public email shown in the footer and contact page. Form submissions go to the inbox below, not here.
general.inquiriesEmailTip: Where contact-form and event-commitment submissions are delivered. Not shown to customers; use a monitored inbox.
general.wazeUrlTip: Full Waze link that opens the branch in the app (e.g. https://waze.com/ul/...).
general.lanesTip: Number of bowling lanes at this branch. Shown in the site's stats.
general.laneDescTip: Short line describing the lanes, shown beside the lane count (e.g. modern lanes with bumpers).
general.logoUrlTip: Logo shown in the site header. Paste a direct image URL — PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best.
general.hoursTip: Set each day's opening and closing times, or mark it closed. Shown on the contact page and used for the open/closed badge.
general.hasNoticeTip: When on, a pop-up appears the first time a visitor enters the site — useful for holiday hours or closures.
general.hasGymboreeTip: When on, the Gymboree (indoor playground) section is shown on the home page.
general.noticeTitleTip: Headline of the pop-up notice. Keep it short (e.g. Holiday hours).
general.noticeBodyTip: Body of the pop-up notice; explain the update or give instructions to visitors.
general.contactTitleTip: Heading of the contact block in the footer/contact area (e.g. Get in touch).
general.contactIntroTip: Short sentence under the contact heading inviting visitors to reach out.
general.footerNoteTip: Small print at the bottom of every page, such as a tagline or credit.
general.seoTitleTip: Page title in browser tabs, bookmarks and Google results. Aim for under ~60 characters.
general.seoDescriptionTip: Summary under the title in search results. Aim for ~150 characters describing the branch.

home.title: Home page
home.heroTitleTip: The large headline at the very top of the home page — the first thing visitors read.
home.heroSubtitleTip: Supporting sentence under the hero title that expands on the headline.
home.heroCtaLabelTip: Text on the main hero button (e.g. Book now). Keep it to a few words.
home.featureLabelTip: Short title of the feature in the strip below the hero (e.g. 20 lanes).
home.featureIconTip: Icon shown with the feature. Enter a lowercase Lucide icon name (e.g. bowling). Browse names at lucide.dev.
home.featureDescriptionTip: One line explaining the feature, shown under its label.
home.servicesTitleTip: Heading above the services list on the home page.
home.servicesIntroTip: Intro paragraph under the services heading.
home.serviceTitleTip: Name of this service card (e.g. Corporate events).
home.serviceDescriptionTip: Short description shown on the service card.
home.serviceImageTip: Image for the service card. Paste a direct image URL; a landscape photo fits best.
home.pricingHint: The game price list shown on the home page.
home.pricingEyebrowTip: Small label above the pricing title (e.g. Prices) that sets context for the section.
home.pricingTitleTip: Main heading of the pricing section.
home.pricingDescriptionTip: Intro text under the pricing title, e.g. what the price includes.
home.pricingWeekdaysLabelTip: Label for the weekday price row (e.g. Sun–Thu).
home.pricingWeekdaysPriceTip: Weekday price as free text, including the currency (e.g. ₪32 per game).
home.pricingWeekendLabelTip: Label for the weekend and holiday price row (e.g. Fri–Sat & holidays).
home.pricingWeekendPriceTip: Weekend and holiday price as free text, including the currency.
home.pricingThirdGameLabelTip: Label for the third-game offer row.
home.pricingThirdGamePriceTip: Price shown for the third game, e.g. a discount or 'free'.
home.pricingThirdGameNoteTip: Extra condition shown with the third-game row (e.g. same group, same day).
home.pricingSoldierNoteTip: Details of the soldier discount (e.g. valid with a military ID).
home.pricingBirthdayEyebrowTip: Small label above the birthdays block in the pricing section.
home.pricingBirthdayTitleTip: Heading of the birthdays promo within the pricing section.
home.pricingBirthdayDescriptionTip: Text describing the birthday package, shown under its title.
home.pricingBirthdayCtaLabelTip: Text on the button that links to the birthdays/events page.
home.galleryTitleTip: Heading above the photo gallery on the home page.
home.imageUrlTip: A gallery photo. Paste a direct image URL; landscape photos display best.
home.imageAltTip: Describes the photo for screen readers and when the image fails to load. Keep it short and factual.
home.reviewsTitleTip: Heading above the customer reviews section.
home.reviewAuthorTip: Name of the reviewer shown with the quote (e.g. Dana L.).
home.reviewRatingTip: Star rating from 1 to 5, shown as stars next to the review.
home.reviewQuoteTip: The review text shown to visitors. A sentence or two works best.
home.contactTitleTip: Heading of the contact section at the bottom of the home page.
home.contactIntroTip: Short text under the contact heading inviting visitors to send a message.
home.subjectLabelTip: One choice in the contact form's Subject dropdown (e.g. Birthday inquiry).

menu.title: Menu
menu.heading: Heading
menu.headingTip: The main heading at the top of the menu page.
menu.introTip: Short text under the menu heading, e.g. a note about kitchen hours.
menu.categoryLabelTip: Name of the menu section grouping the items below it (e.g. Starters, Drinks).
menu.itemNameTip: Name of the dish or drink as it appears on the menu.
menu.itemDescriptionTip: Optional details such as ingredients or portion size, shown under the item name.
menu.itemAmountTip: Price in whole shekels, digits only (e.g. 45). Leave blank to hide the price.

events.title: Events
events.description: Each event type defines its own package, steps, upgrades and form fields.
events.typeNameTip: Display name of the event type, shown in menus and page titles (e.g. Birthdays).
events.typeSlugTip: URL identifier in English — lowercase, hyphen-separated (e.g. birthdays). Appears in the page address.
events.heroTitleTip: Main headline at the top of this event type's page.
events.heroDescriptionTip: Intro paragraph under the event page's headline.
events.packageAmountTip: Base package price in whole shekels, digits only (e.g. 1200).
events.packageChildrenCountTip: How many children the base price covers. Extra children are charged at the rate below.
events.extraChildAmountTip: Price per child beyond the included count, in whole shekels.
events.depositAmountTip: Advance deposit needed to hold the date, in whole shekels.
events.formIntroTip: Text shown at the top of the booking form to guide the customer.
events.formTermsTip: Terms and conditions shown on the booking form; the customer confirms these when submitting.
events.requiresSignatureTip: When on, the booking form adds a signature field the customer must sign to submit.
events.stepTitleTip: Title of one step in the 'How it works' timeline.
events.stepDescriptionTip: What happens in this step, shown under its title.
events.lineLabelTip: One item included in the package, shown as a bullet in the 'What's included' list.
events.upgradeLabelTip: Name of an optional paid add-on the customer can choose.
events.upgradeAmountTip: Price of the upgrade in whole shekels. Leave blank if it varies.
events.formFieldsTip: The fields a customer fills in on this event's booking form. Drag to reorder.
events.fieldKeyTip: Internal identifier in English — letters, digits and underscores only (e.g. child_count). Must be unique in the form.
events.fieldTypeTip: The kind of input shown to the customer (text, number, date, dropdown…). Some types reveal extra options below.
events.fieldLabelTip: Label shown above this field on the booking form (e.g. Number of children).
events.fieldPlaceholderTip: Faint example text inside the empty field hinting at the expected input.
events.fieldMinTip: Smallest number the customer may enter. Applies to number fields only.
events.fieldMaxTip: Largest number the customer may enter. Applies to number fields only.
events.optionValueTip: Value stored when this option is chosen — English, no spaces (e.g. hall_a).
events.optionLabelTip: The option text the customer sees in the dropdown.
events.fieldRequiredTip: When on, the customer must fill this field before the form can be submitted.

locations.name: Name

locations.slugTip: URL identifier in English — lowercase, hyphen-separated (e.g. ramat-gan). Appears in the page address.
